test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The French had regarded the scholar as a usurper.

options.text: The scholar was being regarded as a usurper by the French.
The scholar has been regarded as a usurper by the French.
The scholar was regarded as a usurper by the French.
The scholar had been regarded as a usurper by the French.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The scholar had been regarded as a usurper by the French.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in the past perfect tense, indicated by **"had regarded."**
 
• In the passive voice, **"had been regarded"** maintains the past perfect tense.
